title: pmkit local tracker config
description: The config of the pmkit local tracker, in .issues/config.yaml. The rules between keys (the two prefixes differ, every category has a status, default_status names a status) are checked by pmkit validate, not by this schema. Keys pmkit does not know are allowed.

version.title: Tracker format
version.description: The format version of the tracker folder. pmkit migrate changes it; do not edit it by hand.

id_prefix.title: Issue ID prefix
id_prefix.description: 2 to 5 capital letters, as in ISS-7K3Q. Must differ from epic_prefix.

epic_prefix.title: Epic ID prefix
epic_prefix.description: 2 to 5 capital letters, as in EPC-1. Must differ from id_prefix.

id_style.title: ID style
id_style.description: random draws 4 Crockford base32 characters (ISS-7K3Q); numbered takes one more than the highest number in use (ISS-12). Changing it keeps the existing IDs.

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.description: The workflow statuses, by name. Each one belongs to a category, and every category needs at least one status.

additionalProperties.title: Status
additionalProperties.description: A workflow status. Its key is the name commands use.

category.title: Category
category.description: The category the status belongs to. Reports and metrics group statuses by category.

default_status.title: Default status
default_status.description: The status a new issue starts in. Must be a key of statuses.

types.title: Issue types
types.description: The issue types, at least one.

priorities.title: Priorities
priorities.description: The priorities, highest first, at least one.

unit.title: Estimate unit
unit.description: What estimates count. With points or hours, scale holds numbers such as 1, 2, 3, 5, 8. With sizes, scale holds strings such as S, M, L.

scale.title: Estimate scale
scale.description: The values an estimate can take, numbers or strings (such as S, M, L for sizes).

members.title: Members
members.description: The people and agents who work on issues, by member ID: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (fred), or agent: and a name (agent:claude).

additionalProperties.title: Member
additionalProperties.description: A member. Its key is the ID that assignee and actor fields use.

email.title: Email
email.description: The email pmkit matches against the git user email to find the acting member.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: The share of a full sprint the member works, from 0 to 1.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Numbers the commands use when the user gives none. Any key other than sprint_start_weekday is a whole number of 1 or more.

stale_days.title: Stale days
stale_days.description: Days without an update after which backlog grooming calls an issue stale.

stuck_business_days.title: Stuck business days
stuck_business_days.description: Business days without an event after which the standup calls an in-progress or in-review issue stuck.

sprint_length_days.title: Sprint length in days
sprint_length_days.description: The length of a new sprint when no end date is given.

sprint_start_weekday.title: Sprint start weekday
sprint_start_weekday.description: The weekday a new sprint starts on.

velocity_window.title: Velocity window
velocity_window.description: The number of past sprints velocity averages over.

status_update_window_days.title: Status update window in days
status_update_window_days.description: The period a status report covers when its epic has no earlier update.

additionalProperties.title: Other default
additionalProperties.description: A default this version of pmkit does not name. A whole number of 1 or more.

auto_commit.title: Auto commit
auto_commit.description: true makes every tracker write commit its own change.
